sents.d: Retainers are where UGC income becomes predictable instead of feast-or-famine.

A brand that's happy with one video often needs ongoing content for new products, seasons, or ad refreshes — proposing a monthly retainer (a set number of videos per month at a slightly discounted bundled rate) turns a one-off client into recurring income.

Delivering reliably on your first project, hitting deadlines and being easy to work with, matters more to most brands than being the cheapest option when they're deciding whether to keep working with you.
Retainer clients are worth prioritizing over chasing a constant stream of new one-off deals, since the sales effort per dollar earned is dramatically lower once a relationship is established.

take: Deliver reliably, then offer happy brands a monthly retainer.
